title: Income-tax Act — Section 5 (Scope of total income)

content.overview: Section 5 defines the scope of total income by residence: resident, resident but not ordinarily resident, and non-resident.
content.glance: Section 5 defines the scope of total income by residence: resident, resident but not ordinarily resident, and non-resident.
content.study: The total income of a resident includes income received or deemed received in India, income accruing or arising or deemed to accrue or arise in India, and income accruing or arising outside India. A non-resident is taxed on the Indian-source and deemed Indian-source limbs. Residence is determined under section 6.
